lesson.title: New Chord: E minor (+ Make the Em shape + one strum)
lesson.one_line_promise: Make the Em shape + one strum.
objectives: Make the Em shape + one strum using Em
Keep changes clean before adding speed

chords._schema: strings ordered low E (6) to high e (1). frets: null = muted/not played, 0 = open. fingers: 0 = open, 1 = index, 2 = middle, 3 = ring, 4 = pinky, null = muted.

Em.name: E minor
Em.note: Verified deterministically by chord-theory-check.js (2026-08-08) as E B G.

exercises.name: Make the E minor shape

params.fingers: string 6: fret 0 finger 0; string 5: fret 2 finger 2; string 4: fret 2 finger 3; string 3: fret 0 finger 0; string 2: fret 0 finger 0; string 1: fret 0 finger 0

exercises.coaching: Bring your hand up to the neck. E minor is just a shape — land the fingers, let the others ring open. That right there is a real chord.

exercises.name: One clean down-strum
exercises.purpose: Strum through the sounding strings without catching.
exercises.coaching: Keep that shape and strum straight down. Wrist loose. If a string buzzes, press a touch closer to the fret. When it rings clean, that is your first real win.

avatar_coaching_copy.intro: Group 2: First Chord: Em. Make the Em shape + one strum. Today the new shape is E minor — it spells E B G.
avatar_coaching_copy.ex1_intro: Bring your hand up to the neck. E minor is just a shape — land the fingers, let the others ring open. That right there is a real chord.
avatar_coaching_copy.results: A cleaner rep than last time means your hands are learning. That is the only metric that matters here.
avatar_coaching_copy.wrap: Logged. Next lesson builds on this.
